1091500.title: Cyberpunk 2077
1091500.notes: Use the real bin/x64 executable; preserve existing proxies.

spider-man2.exe.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
spider-man2.exe.notes: Intel/AMD: ray tracing with DXGI spoofing can crash at startup. Use FSR/XeSS in game. Enable the matching native FG option; DLSSG must be enabled to provide HUD-less frames.

spider man 2.exe.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
spider man 2.exe.notes: Intel/AMD: ray tracing with DXGI spoofing can crash at startup. Use FSR/XeSS in game. Enable the matching native FG option; DLSSG must be enabled to provide HUD-less frames.

spider-man remastered.exe.title: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered
spider-man remastered.exe.notes: Keep DXGI spoofing off to avoid the Intel/AMD ray-tracing startup crash. DLSSG on Intel/AMD requires -forceReflexMarkers in launcher options; FSR 3.1 FG avoids that requirement.

midnightsuns.exe.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns
midnightsuns.exe.notes: FSR2 input is unsupported. This is a Streamline 1 game; its documented Nukem FG route cannot output XeSS FG. Use d3d12.dll beside the Win64 game executable. The alternate dbghelp route needs separate engine-file changes and is not automated.

dcs.exe.title: DCS World
dcs.exe.notes: Install beside DCS.exe in bin, not bin-mt. No native FG route is documented. The reported FakeNvapi/FSR4 issue concerns FSR4 output, not a verified XeSS failure.
